scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "yarn workspace frontend dev" "yarn workspace backend dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace backend build && yarn workspace frontend build
scripts.lint: yarn workspace backend lint && yarn workspace frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace backend typecheck && yarn workspace frontend typecheck
scripts.test: yarn workspace backend test && yarn workspace frontend test
scripts.contract:generate: yarn workspace backend contract:generate && yarn workspace frontend contract:generate
scripts.contract:check: yarn workspace backend contract:generate && yarn workspace frontend contract:generate && git diff --exit-code contracts/openapi.json frontend/src/shared/api/generated
